basic_details.job_title: UPSDMA Internship Program Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 27 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Graduate and postgraduate students can apply for 27 seats in the six-month Internship Program of the Uttar Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (Uttar Pradesh Rajya Aapda Prabandhan Pradhikaran) / Relief Commissioner Office. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 13 December 2026, 23:59 hrs. Interns receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 10,000 per month. Advertisement No. 1166/UPSDMA/Internship/2026-27 is dated 12 November 2026.

qualification.details: The 27 seats are all in one Internship Program at the Uttar Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority / Relief Commissioner Office. The notice does not give a subject-wise or category-wise break-up of the seats. | Who can apply: Graduate and Post Graduate students from renowned universities and colleges, as per the Internship guidelines. Preference: Students of NAAC A++ and A+ graded Universities/Colleges/Institutes will be given preference. Age limit: Not specified in the notice. Stipend: A fixed stipend of Rs. 10,000/- per month is paid to interns during the internship period. Duration: The internship period is 06 months. | The detailed eligibility conditions are in the Internship guideline on sdma.up.gov.in. Candidates should check the official notification and that guideline for the subject-specific eligibility.

important_instructions: Enrolment on the internship seats will be done strictly as per the Internship guideline. Candidates must read the Internship Guideline before applying for the Internship Programme. Applications must be sent in the application format available on sdma.up.gov.in.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application by email to [email protected] by 13 December 2026, 23:59 hrs. Use the application format that the notice provides through the UP SDMA website, sdma.up.gov.in. The notice does not mention an email subject line or any postal route. Download the detailed Internship guideline and the application format from the UP SDMA website, sdma.up.gov.in. Read the Internship Guideline. The notice asks candidates to read it before applying. Prepare the application in the prescribed application format. Email the application to [email protected] by 13 December 2026, 23:59 hrs.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The 27 seats are all in one Internship Program at the Uttar Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority / Relief Commissioner Office. The notice does not give a subject-wise or category-wise break-up of the seats. Who can apply: Graduate and Post Graduate students from renowned universities and colleges, as per the Internship guidelines. Preference: Students of NAAC A++ and A+ graded Universities/Colleges/Institutes will be given preference. Age limit: Not specified in the notice. Stipend: A fixed stipend of Rs. 10,000/- per month is paid to interns during the internship period. Duration: The internship period is 06 months. The detailed eligibility conditions are in the Internship guideline on sdma.up.gov.in. Candidates should check the official notification and that guideline for the subject-specific eligibility.

faq.question: Q1. How many seats are there in the UPSDMA Internship Program 2026?
faq.answer: The UPSDMA Internship Program 2026 has 27 seats at the Uttar Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority / Relief Commissioner Office.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the UPSDMA Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be emailed to [email protected] by 13 December 2026, 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the UPSDMA Internship Program?
faq.answer: Graduate and Post Graduate students from renowned universities and colleges can apply, as per the Internship guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for UPSDMA interns?
faq.answer: Interns receive a fixed stipend of Rs. 10,000/- per month during the 06-month internship period.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the UPSDMA Internship 2026?
faq.answer: Download the Internship guideline and the application format from sdma.up.gov.in. Then email your application to [email protected] by 13 December 2026, 23:59 hrs.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the UPSDMA Internship Program?
faq.answer: The UPSDMA Internship Program runs for 06 months.

faq.question: Q7. Which students get preference in the UPSDMA internship?
faq.answer: Students of NAAC A++ and A+ graded Universities/Colleges/Institutes will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I get the UPSDMA internship application format?
faq.answer: The application format and the detailed Internship guideline can be downloaded from the UP SDMA website, sdma.up.gov.in.
